system.description: You sing a song of longing at a chasm's edge.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the bridge sheds light 30' along its whole length.
outcomes.success: A permanent, translucent bridge of solid light spans a gap of up to 500'. It is beautiful.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the time and materials are lost.
outcomes.ruin: The bridge forms, but it will vanish beneath the next creature to reach its middle. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
